mission_09: Fantastic! You have implemented two foundational quantum optimization algorithms. QAOA solves combinatorial optimization problems by encoding the objective as a cost Hamiltonian and alternating between cost and mixer unitaries, with classical optimization of the rotation angles. VQE finds ground state energies of quantum systems using a hardware-efficient ansatz that balances expressivity with implementability on near-term devices. Both algorithms exemplify the hybrid quantum-classical paradigm: quantum circuits prepare complex states that are hard to simulate classically, while classical optimizers navigate the parameter landscape. These algorithms are the primary candidates for demonstrating quantum advantage on NISQ devices, with applications ranging from MaxCut and portfolio optimization (QAOA) to molecular simulation and materials science (VQE).
